questions.question: Explain how the Earth is divided into four hemispheres.
questions.expected_answer: The equator divides the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere. The Greenwich Meridian, at zero degrees longitude, together with the one hundred and eighty degree line on the other side of the Earth, divides it into the Eastern Hemisphere and the Western Hemisphere.

questions.question: In which hemispheres is South Africa? Explain your answer.
questions.expected_answer: South Africa is in the Southern Hemisphere because it lies south of the equator, and in the Eastern Hemisphere because it lies east of the Greenwich Meridian.

questions.question: Describe South Africa's position using degrees of latitude and longitude.
questions.expected_answer: South Africa lies roughly between twenty-two degrees south at the Limpopo River and thirty-five degrees south at Cape Agulhas, and roughly between sixteen degrees east on the west coast and thirty-three degrees east on the north-east coast near Kosi Bay.
